title: The invoice goes into the payer's IBS batch
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a test organization connected to IBS.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, the customer the work is for, with its own IBS account number.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer, with an IBS account number different from customer A's.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in Complete, ready to invoice, billed to customer B.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Open the Finance tab.
  3. Click Create Invoice.
  4. Open the IBS batch the invoice was added to.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens for customer A.

Step 2:

  • The Finance tab shows Create Invoice.

Step 3:

  • The invoice is created.

Step 4:

  • Work order 1's invoice is in the batch under customer B's IBS number.
  • It is not under customer A's IBS number.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12321 (Story 19, IBS, invoice export and Public API)

  • S19-R1: “IBS uses the Bill To's IBS account: its remit-to, approval and batch.”
  • S19-R3: “The remit-to, the "(IBS#: [number])" after the Bill To's name and the IBS batch read the saved number.”
